reviews.comment: I will be honest, this class is a lot of work, especially if you are not a writing-person. You read a ton and analyze a lot. BUT, I loved this class and the prof is AMAZING. Please please take him if you need an English credit (or if you're a nerd). I learned so much about comics and learned new ways to view them.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Matt is super friendly and very understanding of college student lives. You have 2 homeowrks every week and, half of the time, textbook readings. He gives great feedback on assignments. I am a STEM major, but I thoroughly enjoyed this class. Dr. Matt encourages various opinions in class. Get ready to participate in discussion!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment:
One of the best English professors I've had. He is extremely approachable, willing to help, and actually teaches. You should expect 1-2 hours of homework per week, and you need to make sure you sit with people you like the first week because that's who you work with the whole semester.

Just know, all assigned readings and discussions lean left.
He is so nice, funny, and smart! He does grade essays pretty hard but he offers a bunch of extra credit. He really wants you to succeed.

Really enjoyed this class! Interactive and participation heavy, and discussions were always interesting. He does a great job of setting you up for success with assignments (clearly communicates expectations and even gives work days for papers). He was always super accessible and wanted to see us succeed. Highly recommend! One of my favorite profs.

Big fan of McKinney! He makes you work hard (I had 3 assignments most weeks with dense texts to read), and it's really important that you do your work. Participate in class! Attendance is required. Cares about his students, is easily accessible, and gives helpful feedback on everything. Exams were somewhat difficult, but always with extra credit.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Matt's rhet in cultural context is an amazing course. You get to learn A LOT about pop cultures and specific literary terminologies, and he always inspires you to think outside the box in terms of analysis. Easy grader overall and reading was not bad, however get ready to have homework on a daily basis, which were also more of a completion.

Dr. Matt is a very respectable and caring prof who understands that students have a lot on their plate. He is very understanding and flexible when it comes to deadlines. He is a very enjoyable person and I looked forward to class. Lots of books to read/respond to and you have to try on the papers. Very enjoyable and worth the effort

He is awesome and such an easy grader! Dr. Matt is the best option for a professor (especially for honors technical writing). I spent maybe 2 or 3 hours a week out of class max, and got a 98. He cares, is intentionally inclusive, and is honestly hilarious. Also, the group project contracts that he uses make sure you aren't the only one working.
Work is extremely instructive and even more so manageable. Enjoyable lectures with occasional stories and jokes. Best prof I've had so far in English department.

Dr.McKinney is the sweetest professor you will ever have in an english course. He makes learning really fun and you can tell he really cares about his students. He is really understanding and gives good feedback on assignments. If you want to take an english course I highly recommend you take it with him.

Dr. Mckinney is one of my fav professors ever. He truly cares about his students, and it is shown. The work itself can be difficult, but he makes it seem a lot easier. He is a very fast grader and is always available to help. Would definitely recommend taking him!

Dr. McKinney is for sure one of my favorite professors I have had at A&M!! He wants you to succeed and is more than willing to help! Multiple readings throughout the semester but nothing that is not manageable! He is a great person and really funny in class! TAKE HIM!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dr. McKinney is great! There are 2 exams open note, and 2 papers. Every day there was a class activity that counted as attendance so don't skip too many classes. Very intelligent and helped me understand the material better. You have at least 2 homework assignments per week over readings which are not bad at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Textbook is free and the homework is more than manageable, I can't speak his praises enough

One of the best profs I've ever had! He's funny, really knowledgeable, and so helpful. I learned more about grammar and style than from all other English classes combined (I'm an English major). Graded on biweekly reading responses, 2 essays, and 2 exams. Lot of reading and info but its really useful. Offered ~50 points extra credit this semester.

The type of professor that makes you excited to come to class. Plays Lofi-hip-hop beats while we work and even brought us homemade guacamole the last week of class. But not only this, he taught the content well and was always willing to give detailed feedback and advice. Truly the embodiment of what a college professor should be.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: If you have the opportunity to take Dr. McKinney, you definitely should! He is very knowledgeable, friendly, and accommodating. The course material can be challenging, but he invites questions and discussion. There are essays, open-note exams, and homework responses, but don't fret because he accepts late assignments and offers extensions!

A nightmare of a course in the summer. There is assignments/task due every day for the 5-week course I took. A major group project that requires quick thinking and a lot of busywork. Professor was super easy to reach and tries to respond quickly. He is also an easy grader for the most part. May be a less painful course during a regular semester.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: A great class to take and a great prof. This class does require a lot of time and effort, but if you do the assignments on time and put in the effort he will grade you with flying colors. His assignments are very detailed and he is always great at answering emails if you need any help with anything.

Not a bad online class at all. You have weekly discussion posts you have to complete which are really easy and not very time consuming. The technical writing is fairly easy and the prof and TA provide a lot of help and resources. So long as you do the work on time they'll grade pretty leniently. There's also a chance to rewrite assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Honestly one of the best profs I've ever had at A&M. You can tell he really cares about his students. His feedback on assignments and papers is incredibly thorough, and he answers all your questions completely. This class can be tough, and you certainly have to do your homework, but I can't think of a better prof to teach such a dense class.
